'''Rice and beans jollof''' is a typical Nigerian food made from rice and beans. It is served with beef, chicken or [[Cookbook:Moin Moin|moin moin]].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dried [[Cookbook:Beans|beans]]
*2 fresh [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]]
*5 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]] or [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|stock cube]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] or to taste
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Parboiling|parboiled]] [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]

== Equipment ==

* Pot
* [[Cookbook:Stovetop|Stove]]
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]
* Bowl
* Pan
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* Spoon 

==Procedure==
#Rinse the beans, and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in water until tender. Drain the cooked beans.
#Grind together the chiles, tomatoes, and onions to make a [[Cookbook:Puréeing|purée]].
#Heat a thin layer of oil in a pan, and add the purée. Season with stock cube and salt, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 3 minutes.
#Stir in the parboiled rice and beans, and cook for 5 minutes.
#Serve with beef, chicken, or moin-moin.
